newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ILLNESS AND INJURIES FORCE BORO OUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ILLNESS AND INJURIES FORCE BORO OUT.

text.p: Middlesbrough's English premier league clash at Blackburn on Saturday was called off on Friday after 'Boro found they could not field a side.
They informed the League they could not put out a representative team because of injuries and a virus.
Manager Bryan Robson revealed that 23 of his professionals were ruled out on medical advice.
